identity.name: Overseas Self-Winding
identity.one_liner: The 2016 Overseas — Vacheron's 41mm steel sport-luxury answer to the Royal Oak and Nautilus, with the in-house 5100 calibre, the Maltese cross-inspired bezel, and the quick-change strap system.

provenance_events.description: Vacheron Constantin releases the 4520V as the brand's third-generation Overseas — a 41mm steel sport-luxury watch with the in-house 5100 automatic movement.

narrative.story: The 4520V is the 2016 refresh of the Overseas — Vacheron's third attempt at a steel sport-luxury watch after the 222 (1977) and the first Overseas (1996). The case is 41mm, the movement is the in-house 5100 (a 22K gold rotor automatic), the bezel is Maltese cross-inspired.
narrative.collector_notes: The 5100 movement is one of the most-efficient Vacheron movements: 60-hour reserve, 22K gold rotor, -2/+2 seconds/day accuracy.
